meta.description: Two-factor authentication, role-based access, a security log, properly closed accounts, AI without student data: what Planner does today to protect accounts and data.

entete.accroche: This page only describes what Planner already does. What is in preparation is marked “Coming soon”.

cartes.texte: A one-time code from an authenticator app protects sign-in. Required for the administration, available to teachers, with backup codes.
Student, teacher, administration: each person opens only what their role allows.
Sign-ins, failures, password and two-factor changes: everything is recorded, and the administration can review it.
The calendar subscription address is secret, and anyone can change theirs: the old one stops working at once.
An account that leaves the school is deactivated, then anonymised: the history stays, without a name.
When AI is turned on for your school, it never receives student data, and teachers review what it suggests.

site.titre: This site does not follow you.

cartes.texte: Fonts, images and scripts are served by this site, with no call to another.

cartes.titre: Everything that leaves, in plain sight
cartes.texte: A public list of everything Planner sends outside the school, and to whom.
